text:
Opinions are divided as to whether urban farming can solve food shortages. This essay will consider both perspectives before explaining my own opinion.

On the one hand, supporters argue that urban farming brings fresh food closer to the people who eat it. Rooftop gardens, vertical farms and community plots use empty space in cities, cut transport distances and give residents access to fresh vegetables that would otherwise be expensive or hard to find. Local food costs less to deliver, loses less on the way and strengthens community ties, since neighbours work together and learn about growing. A block of flats that grows salad leaves on its roof, for example, can supply nearby households and restaurants throughout the year. In districts where fresh produce is scarce, this can improve diets and reduce hunger.

On the other hand, critics point out that urban farms cannot grow enough staple crops to end food shortages. Cities lack the land and water needed for wheat, rice and maize, which feed most of the world, and high rents and energy costs make indoor farms expensive. Most urban farms produce leafy vegetables and herbs, which are valuable but provide few calories. A large city that tried to feed itself from its own rooftops, for instance, would run out of space very quickly, because growing enough rice or wheat for millions of residents requires far more land than any city can spare.

To sum up, both positions have their merits; nevertheless, I believe that urban farming is a useful supplement that improves access to fresh food, but it cannot replace rural agriculture or solve shortages on its own.

analysis.type_vi: Discuss both views: nông nghiệp đô thị có giải quyết được thiếu lương thực không

plan.think: Mở bài giữ đúng từ khoá của đề (urban farming, food shortages); thân bài một ủng hộ, thân bài hai chỉ ra giới hạn; kết luận phân biệt 'bổ sung' với 'thay thế'.
Vườn mái nhà, trang trại thẳng đứng, ô đất cộng đồng dùng khoảng trống đô thị; cắt khoảng cách vận chuyển; cư dân có rau tươi. Ví dụ toà nhà trồng xà lách trên mái.
Thành phố thiếu đất và nước cho lúa mì, gạo, ngô; tiền thuê và năng lượng đắt; chủ yếu rau lá và thảo mộc ít calo. Ví dụ thành phố lớn tự nuôi mình từ mái nhà sẽ hết chỗ rất nhanh.
Bổ sung hữu ích nhưng không thay thế nông nghiệp nông thôn.
